title: Chapter 401
text:
His old face was stuck to the ground, and his beautiful robe was stained with dust. It was as if he was being pressed down by a mountain. Rezar could not move at all. He was both shocked and furious. Years of hope had finally appeared. He could not fall in the darkness before dawn no matter what.

Even if the opponent was a strong enemy from the higher world, it was not impossible for him to fight now!

Rezar activated his magic power. Bright red magic power mixed with blue magic power gushed out with his body as the center, creating an intense gale. The expressions of Rex and the other Planet Dawn soldiers who were a hundred meters away all changed.

[Nidorm Repulsion Ring] pushed away enemies within ten meters and was used to deal with enemies at close range. It was a must-learn spell for Planet Dawn Mages. Its power depended on the Mage's ability. The ring released by Rezar was the strongest that Rex had ever seen. It was rumored that only ascenders could have such powerful magic power. This meant that Rezar had reached that level.

Rex's expression tensed up.

This was troublesome.

"Prepare to throw spears as support!"

Rex ordered loudly. The Blue Shield Knights around him all raised their conical spears and prepared to throw them.

In his opinion, Rezar had reached the level of an ascender, so he should be on par with the warriors from the higher world. Just in case, he decided to help. However, when he turned around, he realized that the other mercenaries from the higher world were all calm and had no intention of attacking.

"Don't worry," Lin Ge said with a smile. "Captain Black Star's ability is well known in the mercenary circle of the Garton Star System."

Rex was stunned. He took a closer look and saw through the backflow of magic power. No matter how powerful Rezar's magic power was, Han Xiao was still standing at the same spot, as steady as a rock. His outstretched palm pinned Rezar to the ground like a nail, not moving at all.

At this time, Rezar suddenly felt that the mechanical suit's palm on his head started to generate a terrifying power that made him tremble in fear. It seemed like some powerful attack was about to be released at close range. His weak body would definitely not be able to take it. In his panic, he did not even bother to push Han Xiao away and hurriedly cast all sorts of defensive enhancements on himself.

The next moment, gray energy mist appeared on the Void Dragon mechanical suit. It flowed along the arm and spurted out from the palm. Rezar's head happened to be in the palm, and he welcomed the first wave of power.

Boom!

Intense explosion! Gray fog gushed out!

Like thousands of sharp blades, the gray shockwave spread out in all directions. The ground was instantly covered with gullies, as if it had been plowed. At the center of the explosion, there was a hole with a diameter of nearly two meters.

Before the aftershock of the explosion dissipated, Han Xiao's body glowed with a gray light, and the second Energy Spray erupted.

Void Jet!

Even a lion would need to go all out to catch a rabbit. Even if the enemy was weaker, Han Xiao would not give them a chance and would still go all out. Although Rezar had broken through to Grade B and was at the same level as Han Xiao, he had only just reached the threshold and was not familiar with his own power yet.

Han Technician dealt with this kind of newbie grade B as easily as a father beating his son.

He continuously shot out three Void Jet at full power, consuming 1,170 points of the mechanical suit's energy. Three high damage numbers popped up above Rezar's head, dealing a total of 4,700 HP in just a few seconds. The killing efficiency was extremely high. This was the strongest explosive move without using [Flaming Will]. [Flaming Will] had a cooldown of five minutes, but [Void Jet] did not. It had already become Han Xiao's regular trump card.

The smoke dissipated, and Rezar lay in the hole. His entire body was covered in wounds from the energy impact. Void Jet was a pure energy attack that contained the 'space' attribute. Just like how the ice attribute could slow down and the fire attribute could burn, the space attribute's direct effect was to nullify part of the target's resistance and reduce the damage reduction.

The damage in an extremely short amount of time was more than half of Rezar's HP. Rezar was heavily injured and unconscious. He even had a concussion. A Grade B mini-boss-type character was easily defeated by Han Xiao in less than ten seconds.

After many battles in the past nine months, Han Xiao already knew the various attributes and functions of the Void Dragon mechanical suit very well. Among the lightweight individual mechanical suits of the same grade, the Void Dragon mechanical suit was definitely one of the top. Against Supers of the same grade, Void Jet was an extremely useful ultimate move.

"The difference in strength is actually this big?" Rex's mouth was dry, and his eyes were filled with shock. Rezar, whose strength had increased tremendously, was already one of the top supers on Planet Dawn. Even ten of him would not be able to defeat the current Rezar. However, in front of this mercenary, Rezar was like a baby who could not fight back at all …

Are all the people in the higher world this strong?

The soldiers of Planet Dawn were in a daze. A huge crisis in their eyes was resolved so easily. Everyone felt that it was unreal, as if they were dreaming.

Han Xiao grabbed Rezar by the back of his collar and threw him in front of Rex. The mechanical suit folded automatically, and he returned to his casual clothes.

The hundreds of cannons around him turned back into compressed orbs one after another. Pulled by the magnetic force, they rolled toward him on the ground. One by one, they lined up obediently and crawled back to his belt and the inner lining of his clothes along his legs. It was like hundreds of cannons returning to their nest, and thousands of balls paying homage to their master.

"Done. Pack up."

Han Xiao clapped his hands. With his current strength, it was not difficult for him to dominate Planet Dawn. One word — crush!

As if waking up from a dream, Rex ordered his subordinates to tie Rezar up layer by layer with chains. He explained, "The king wants me to capture Rezar alive and bring him back for a public trial. He also wants me to interrogate him about where he learned the ancient ritual to prevent anyone else from knowing how to absorb the Origin Water …"

"You guys can do whatever you want. My job is done." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

At this time, Rezar slowly woke up. He was dizzy and realized that he was tied up by chains that suppressed magic. The magic in his body was forced to stay still and could not be used. He subconsciously wanted to struggle and resist, but he suddenly saw Han Xiao beside him and quickly stopped. As long as Han Xiao was beside him, resisting would just be asking for humiliation and suffering. However, he could not hold back his anger. He glared at Han Xiao and clenched his teeth.

If it were not for this group of reinforcements from the higher world, he would have succeeded by now. Before this, he would never have expected the Vain Kingdom to be able to summon such powerful reinforcements. These intruders were the culprits that ruined his plan. Rezar was furious.

"Why did you guys stop me? This has nothing to do with you guys …"

Han Xiao shrugged. "Why do you ask so many questions? It's all work. I've dealt with dozens of villains like you. What right do thieves have to complain about the police? If you want to blame someone, blame your bad luck for running into us when you were committing the crime. What's your motive?"

"I just don't want to be trapped on a backward planet forever. Can you understand the feeling of disillusionment and surprise when I found out that we're just one of the countless races in the universe? We're not special, but it also means that we have a lot of companions. I don't want to be ignorant and backward forever. I don't want to stay here and wait for death like the people on this planet. I want to see the real world!" "Since my ritual has failed, there is no need for you to deal with me anymore. Aren't you mercenaries? If they can hire you to deal with me, I can hire you too. Please take me away from Planet Dawn. I can give you all my wealth as a reward. If you don't need it, I can also work for you …" Rezar said as he tugged on the chains, making a rattling sound.

Rezar was still trying his best. The soldiers beside him could not help but become nervous when they heard that. They were afraid that the mercenaries from the higher world would betray them.

Han Xiao did not hesitate and rejected the new mission [Rezar's Request] that popped up on the interface. "Sorry, we Black Star are a trustworthy mercenary group. Furthermore, even if you have a good reason, it's not an excuse to harm the planet," he said calmly.

Rezar was angry and helpless. He did not say anything and let the soldiers pull on his chains.

Back on the ground, the army gathered and rested. They were about to return. Rex found Han Xiao and said solemnly, "Captain Black Star, Captain Lin Ge, on behalf of the Vain Kingdom, I would like to invite all of you to the palace as guests. The king wants to thank you personally. I wonder if you guys have the time …"

"Sure, then we'll go with you guys. We can take a look around Planet Dawn." Han Xiao nodded. Of course, this was an excuse. His main goal was to get information about the signs of the Mutation Disaster. Going through the upper world was the most convenient way to gather information. Since the king had come to him personally, he would not miss it.

"I'll stay too. Let's go together." Lin Ge originally did not want to stay, but when he saw Han Xiao agree, he quickly changed his mind. His goal was to stay with the Black Star Mercenary a little longer and make his presence known.

The alliance army quickly cleaned up the battlefield, and the tribes left separately. The Blue Shield Knights escorted Rezar and headed toward the Vain Kingdom.

…

Late at night.

The Blue Shield Knights were stationed on a plain. The night on Planet Dawn was very dark, and one could not even see their own fingers. Most of the creatures in the wild were dark creatures, and light had the effect of dispelling wild beasts. The knights' temporary camp was equipped with fluorescent lighting spells as a light source. The weak fluorescent light floated in the camp, and they could barely see.

Rezar was locked in a prison van in the middle of the camp. The guards around him kept changing shifts and keeping an eye on him.

Late at night, in a single tent, Han Xiao turned on his galactic communicator and looked at the mercenary hiring interface.
